notes: Useful for regulated cost components and safety obligations.

source_title: Keputusan Menteri Perhubungan Nomor KP 667 Tahun 2022 tentang Pedoman Perhitungan Biaya Jasa Penggunaan Sepeda Motor yang Digunakan untuk Kepentingan Masyarakat yang Dilakukan dengan Aplikasi
evidence_role: tariff regime; regulated fare components

notes: JDIH/Hubud metadata shows status and relation to KP 1001.

source_title: Keputusan Menteri Perhubungan Nomor KP 1001 Tahun 2022 tentang Perubahan atas KP 667 Tahun 2022
observation_period: effective 2022-11-22 until revoked according to JDIH metadata
evidence_role: regulated application-use fee and support-cost framework
key_limitations: Normative ceiling is not evidence of realized deductions. Service scope is passenger motorcycle tariff regime.
notes: JDIH status recorded as Berlaku; includes up to 15% application-use fee and up to 5% support-cost component under defined conditions.

source_title: Presidential communication on online-transport worker protection and revenue sharing
publisher: President of the Republic of Indonesia
service_scope: online transport; scope requires legal-text verification
evidence_role: policy announcement; regulatory implementation context
key_limitations: Announcement is not a substitute for operative legal text; later official communications create status/scope tension.
notes: Kept separate from any Perpres or ministerial decision legal text.

source_title: DPR communication on planned 8% commission implementation for two-wheel passenger services
platform_scope: Gojek and Grab named in communication
evidence_role: implementation statement; fee-policy context
key_limitations: Implementation statement is not operative legal text and does not establish transaction-level realized deductions.
notes: Must be reconciled with service scope and later August 2026 official updates.

source_title: DPR communication on continued finalization/harmonization of online-transport rules
observation_period: status as of 2026-08-18; no later operative Perpres text recovered through 2026-08-27
service_scope: passenger, goods and food services discussed
evidence_role: regulatory-status and scope reconciliation
key_limitations: Official DPR update says broader rule entered finalization/harmonization and targeted completion by end-August/early-September; it does not itself define operative tariff formulas.
notes: As of 2026-08-27 no published operative Perpres text was verified.

source_title: Keputusan Menteri Perhubungan Nomor KP-PHB 532 Tahun 2026 — instrument referenced by minister/platform statements; primary legal text still not recovered
publisher: Kementerian Perhubungan (instrument referenced by Minister/platform statements)
observation_period: reported effective implementation from 2026-07-01; exact instrument text/effective clause pending
service_scope: two-wheel service according to cited implementation statements
evidence_role: candidate operative fee rule requiring primary-text verification
key_limitations: As of 2026-08-27 no primary JDIH/legal text was verified. Secondary reporting quotes the Transport Minister saying the decision had been sent to applicators and notes it was not listed in JDIH on 2026-08-07.
notes: 8% references remain a separate evidence layer from realized deductions.

source_title: inDrive applies 8% commission for two-wheel services after referenced KP-PHB 532/2026
evidence_role: platform-stated deduction implementation
key_limitations: Not transaction-level evidence and not proof of universal realized deduction.
notes: Useful only in platform-stated policy layer until transaction evidence is available.

source_title: Laporan Tahunan Badan Kebijakan Transportasi Tahun Anggaran 2022
sample_population: Official report confirms existence of ATP/WTP ojol survey output
evidence_role: provenance evidence for Kemenhub/BKT survey; policy-research context
key_limitations: Annual report confirms the study but does not provide sufficient respondent-level methodology or metric definitions.
notes: Detailed ATP/WTP report is excluded from quantitative use; regulatory outputs are assessed separately.

source_title: Kenaikan Tarif Ojek Online di Mata Pengguna dan Pengemudi
service_scope: online motorcycle/ride-hailing driver and user survey
sampling_method: Multistage random sampling; face-to-face interviews; 20% random spot-check quality control
evidence_role: driver characteristics; income brackets; service mix; tenure; tariff/WTP perceptions
key_limitations: Daily income is source-reported and not explicitly defined as gross or net; pre-pandemic/pandemic figures are recall responses within the 2022 survey; reported MoE is under a simple-random-sampling assumption.
notes: Scribd is retained as the accessible source locator provided for this report.

source_title: Fairwork Indonesia 2022 Ratings: Labour Standards in the Platform Economy
sample_population: 6-10 workers interviewed per platform under Fairwork methodology, plus desk research and platform-management evidence
sampling_method: diverse purposive/non-probability recruitment; worker interviews explicitly not intended to be representative
evidence_role: logged-in time/work-related cost concepts; platform practices; fair pay context
key_limitations: Worker interviews are designed to establish whether processes/problems exist, not their prevalence; 6-10 workers per platform cannot support national earnings prevalence estimates.
notes: Methodology uses desk research platform evidence and worker interviews.

source_title: Fairwork Indonesia 2025 Ratings
sample_population: 80 workers interviewed in Jakarta between January and March 2025; around eight workers per platform
sampling_method: semi-structured purposive worker interviews complemented by desk research and platform evidence
evidence_role: platform practices; fair pay; work-related costs; working conditions
key_limitations: 2025 worker interviews are Jakarta-based and purposive; they do not estimate national earnings prevalence.
notes: Worker sample covers ride-hailing delivery and home services.

source_title: Policy Brief — Mengakhiri Kerja Tak Layak Ojek Daring
publisher: Institute for Demographic and Affluence Studies (IDEAS)
geography: Internal document discrepancy: narrative states 62 kabupaten/kota; methodology page states 67
evidence_role: Non-probability purposive sampling; enumerator interviews using digital forms plus snowball recruitment through driver networks
access_status: gross earnings, orders, distance, source-reported working hours, workdays, driver-reported deduction brackets, bonuses and driver characteristics
key_limitations: verified_with_caveats
notes: Operating-cost bundle includes fuel plus food/drink; source-reported net income is not project net operating earnings; locality count is internally inconsistent.
column22: Regulatory statements in the brief are not treated as authoritative legal text.

source_title: Pendapatan Ojol Anjlok: Bersih Rp1,7 Juta, Jam Kerja Panjang — reporting IDEAS 2025 survey
evidence_role: secondary summary
access_status: secondary corroboration for earnings hours deductions and cost components
key_limitations: context_only
notes: Secondary reporting cannot replace primary definitions and tables.

source_title: Indeks Harga Konsumen 38 Provinsi di Indonesia 2025 (2022=100)
evidence_role: inflation adjustment and purchasing-power context
key_limitations: CPI is not a driver operating-cost observation and must be geography/period matched for real-value conversion.
notes: Base year 2022=100.

source_title: Indeks Harga Konsumen 150 Kabupaten/Kota di Indonesia 2025 (2022=100)
evidence_role: city-level inflation adjustment and purchasing-power context
key_limitations: Coverage is limited to BPS CPI cities.
notes: Preferred over province/national CPI when observation geography is directly matched.

source_title: Mewujudkan Ekosistem Ojek Online yang Menyejahterakan, Berkelanjutan dan Berkeadilan
publisher: INDEF and Paramadina Public Policy Institute (PPPI)
sampling_method: purposive sampling for survey components; mixed methods
evidence_role: sample-level evidence for promo, tariff, commission perceptions/preferences, platform choice, incentives, safety and related ecosystem context
key_limitations: Purposive sample must not be treated as nationally representative; perceptions/preferences are not realized deductions; CGE outputs are modelled macro evidence rather than driver unit-economics observations.
notes: Copyright notice restricts reproduction without written permission except short attributed quotations.

source_title: Rata-Rata Pendapatan Harian Pengemudi Ojol Awal 2026 — reporting Litbang Kompas survey
sample_population: 482-483 drivers reported across related sources; exact final n unresolved
sampling_method: telephone/online wording differs across secondary reports; original sampling frame unavailable
evidence_role: gross daily earnings distribution; workdays; working hours
key_limitations: Related sources inconsistently report 482 vs 483 respondents. Original questionnaire/sampling frame is unavailable; generic working hours must not be relabelled online/productive hours.
notes: Food plus fuel cannot be treated as project operating cost.

source_title: Banyak Pengemudi Ojol Berharap Aplikator Kurangi Potongan Tarif — reporting Litbang Kompas survey
sampling_method: telephone survey; original sampling frame pending
evidence_role: driver perceptions about deductions and platform policy
key_limitations: Perceptions and desired commission rates are not realized deduction observations.
notes: Same underlying survey family as SRC018; sample is not treated as an independent study.

source_title: Factors affecting online motorcycle-taxi driver income in Jabodetabek
publisher: E-Jurnal Ekonomi dan Bisnis Universitas Udayana
publication_date: publication year to verify from article
evidence_role: local driver income determinants; supporting evidence
key_limitations: Local study is not nationally representative; expenditure definition remains too broad for direct project operating-cost mapping.
notes: Potential supporting source for workload/income relationships; association is not causal.

source_title: Mengakhiri Kerja Tak Layak Ojek Online
publisher: Majalah Sedane; article by Yusuf Wibisono and Muhammad Anwar
observation_period: IDEAS survey December 2025; prior comparison survey April-May 2023
geography: 62 kabupaten/kota, especially Java and Sumatra agglomerations
sample_population: 1,018 drivers in 2025 survey; 225 drivers in Jabodetabek in 2023 survey
evidence_role: methodology/provenance corroboration for IDEAS policy brief; descriptive survey context
key_limitations: Article is not the primary policy-brief file and reports 62 localities while the primary brief contains a 62-vs-67 internal discrepancy.
notes: High-value provenance source because authors are the researchers and methodology is stated explicitly.

source_title: Pertamina fuel prices effective 1 July 2026 — secondary reproduction of official Pertamina Patra Niaga price information

source_title: Fairwork Methodology

key_limitations: Methodology explains process evidence, not population prevalence; country reports must still be checked for year-specific deviations.
